Main features and changes:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40644479/5677d06dbbf9bd975204761b4e02c6c9be9c5d9b.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]the game is now oriented to a top-down perspective. notes.title: Sci-Fantasy Defence V9 - Physics Update
notes.notes:
[h2]New[/h2]

The update is aimed at close combat and encouraging more physical activity (including body and legs).

[b]Weapon physics[/b] - now have weight and interact with other objects
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40644479/cf2a40431888b705c6827a849ed18b0733ef59b0.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40644479/a09a68fa5a037b5b9db38353ceb61f626b405b03.gif[/img]

[b]New attack mechanics.[/b] Enemies no longer bite immediately, as before, without giving the opportunity to switch to close combat. Now they jump on the player's head before biting, which allows you to crouch or step aside in real life, increasing physical activity and giving various opportunities for counterattack (shoot during or after crouching, push into traps, etc.) with the passive effect Adrenaline Rush. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40644479/aa2c74ccefcf8ad24db254edb36782402c5187be.gif[/img]

[b]Adrenaline Rush[/b] - new passive effect that activates when an enemy jumps on you to bite. Slows down time, but also slows movement speed (but not weapon movement speed, while still retaining the effect of weight)

New weapon - [b]bare fists.[/b] Just leave at least one weapon slot empty for use and hit enemies in slowmo.

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
Some lights/colors improvements

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
Fixed some bugs

notes.title: Sci-Fantasy Defence Update 8.7
notes.notes:
[h2]New[/h2]
Zombies know getting random buff
[list]
[*] electric - creates EMP explosion after death, that deactivates near traps for 10 sec
[*] poisoned - immune to poison and make damage to closest players after death
[*] accelerated - high movement speed (can activate many traps if not killed in time)
[*] steely - immunity to physical damage
[*] telekinetic - immune to telekinesis/antigravity, throws nearby zombies in the direction of its movement upon death
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40644479/d9041840a6d78f3b3b39150f2f5f0c3c09e72a39.gif[/img]

[b]Climbing. [/b] Added ropes to select a vantage point (for example, for building or shooting from above).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40644479/1ef84281f253da1efd8b4ce54025e92b77030cbf.gif[/img]

[b]Climbing motion.[/b] Previously, it was only possible to move by sprinting when smooth locomotion was off, but now you can climb on the ground, capturing space and pulling towards. Useful if you experience motion sickness and/or want more physical activity.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40644479/15ed16fb3cfbb36e08a4a81b042e8b083b344073.gif[/img]

[b]Gesture based actions. [/b] Cast spells using gestures with the telekinesis gloves. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40644479/b078cb522d51358ed4887557bd658a2c0b561f4c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40644479/a8bd4b922bc2505979998bd025593873928240a4.gif[/img]

[h2]Map 1 - Changes/Improvements[/h2]
Decreased width, but added height variations, lava, platforms and replaced wires upper lava.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40644479/0bbfbe392ed740ed52464f356470f8c345f8550f.png[/img]

VFX environment collisions
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40644479/713b224ea677871133cc1dd90f195022a01a5d5d.gif[/img]

Active ragdoll boss
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40644479/26bf92cea361afd9191c2202c2a374c46dc8f485.gif[/img]

[h2]Improvements / Changes[/h2]
Added flesh stat for enemy limbs. Now after poison/burning an active ragdoll skeleton will run for some time. This is per limb mechanic, so if only half of the body was under fire/poison, then half of the body will turn into a skeleton, not the whole body. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40644479/6478c08f69d174fd4a47f7a402ef8ee83f8b8c01.gif[/img]

[h2]Improvements / Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Slowmo activation moved from chest to wrists. Now need to bring wrists together and press the grab button to activate/deactivate the slow mode
[*] Improved performance

Frame drops when some effects are too close to camera

notes.title: Sci-Fantasy Defence Big Update v1.1.0 Released
notes.notes:
This update was created to make every game more different by adding rogue-like random cards reward after every wave. Now there is available only Mini Statue building from start, no auras or similar buildings. You should get cards for getting access to these buildings and their upgrade is more expensive than earlier, also there are a lot of new limits per turrets, so there is no only one effective strategy to spam aura towers anymore. But on the other hand, you can get a lot of bonuses from the cards and adjust to them, which diversifies the gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40644479/c8ec37ea99b9d04707691aeb9ce4898c9028a83f.png[/img]

[h2]Features Overview[/h2]
[list]
[*] There are 3 types of cards. Building -  to get access to the buildings, knowledge - allows to use skulls to upgrade weapons, buff - buff building for adding extra stats or features.
[*] The pace of the game has been increased to prevent boredom between waves and to allow more random cards to be obtained after waves are completed. So there is decreased time between waves, cheaper Ore Mine, researches are completing faster now. Also, there are 9 extra waves. Creatures' progression rate has also increased: now they will improve every ~4 waves gaining a level. Those with 2+ level will glow in different colors.
[*] In addition, points are now counted differently, because before players received too large a value that was not recorded in the leaderboard. Therefore, the leaderboard has been reset. 
[/list]

[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Rogue-like cards choice reward after completing every wave
[*] Added 9 new waves
[*] Added glowing textures to show creature level
[*] Auras has limits per turret now, but can be improved specific turret type by cards
[*] Auras cost was increased and next level cost multiplier increased from 2 to 3 as well
[*] Added armour stat that decreasing damage
[*] Added armour to creatures and every final wave stage armour increases as well
[*] Added 25 armour to wall
[*] Bones max count limited by 1 billion
[*] Added new building - Mini Statue, that allows to use Statue from your base
[/list]

[h2]Improvements/Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved values infos format
[*] Improved ladderboard values format
[*] Decreased time between waves from 5/3 to 3/2
[*] Discount tower now gives 30% less expendables' usage, instead of 11%. Initial max limit 30% instead of 99%. Can be upgraded to 90% by cards
[*] Improved Armory: added weapons preview and now you can see any buffs or effects info
[*] Now it will show how many points you have scored even if you have not updated the ladder board result
